blocks.text: The module documents itself as a name-to-callable resolver with no execution on import. The opening tables classify provider accounts by strengths and natural roles without exposing credential values.
blocks.title: Registry boundary and capability data

blocks.text: A ContextVar stores the prompt dictionary for one request or CLI context. The cache is keyed by the same shared or per-user memory-bus key that the role-library functions use.
blocks.title: Per-context role prompt cache

blocks.text: Legacy bare strings are wrapped into metadata objects, while missing capability tags are added in place. _load_prompts bootstraps missing stores from the seed dictionary, writes only when needed, and caches the result.
blocks.title: Role-store migration and loading

blocks.text: The public role-library functions read briefs or metadata and update source, hire counts, pin state, and capability tags. Bulk hire recording performs one write for a batch and preserves existing metadata.
blocks.title: Role metadata operations

blocks.text: REAL_ACTION_ROLES distinguishes agents that perform concrete actions from reasoning roles. Dedicated modules are named explicitly; other roles can fall through to generic_worker.
blocks.title: Dedicated action mapping

blocks.text: Aliases are normalized into one lookup, and a conservative difflib fallback handles near matches. resolve_role checks exact dedicated names, aliases, fuzzy matches, then returns generic_worker.
blocks.title: Specialized role normalization

blocks.text: Agent modules are imported only after registry symbols exist, preventing circular-import failures. REGISTRY then associates public agent names with callable entry points and whether they need a cycle number.
blocks.title: Late imports and callable registry

blocks.text: resolve returns the callable stored for a known agent name. Missing names raise a descriptive KeyError rather than returning a silent no-op.
blocks.title: Strict callable lookup

gotchas: Per-user role-library scope requires a user_id and raises instead of falling back to the shared key.
Unknown roles resolve to generic_worker unless they match a dedicated real-action alias.
The bottom import block is intentionally delayed to avoid a circular import during registry initialization.

purpose: This module is the role library and dispatch registry for the EO system. It persists role metadata through the memory bus, supports scoped caching and role aliases, and exposes a final callable lookup for execution.
